entities.summary: Tatsuya Nakamura (b. 1965-01-04, Toyama Prefecture) was a visual artist or sculptor of the Contemporary era, characterized by technology, globalization, and rapid social change, active in Toyama Prefecture and Japan. Known in the fields of japan, composers & musicians, asia.
